Luminate - Telehealth | Patient scheduling and virtual consultations

  • Developed patient-facing appointment journeys for provider availability, slot selection, booking, confirmation, rescheduling, and video consultations on iOS and Android.
  • Built responsive screens and reusable features with Clean Architecture and GetX; integrated REST APIs, JSON models, authentication, and structured validation and error handling.
  • Integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging and supported local persistence, caching, request retries, and background notification flows for a more reliable experience on variable networks.
  • Collaborated with product, design, and backend teams; contributed to testing, production debugging, native iOS/Android issue resolution, and Jenkins CI/CD workflows.

Consumer, health, and commerce mobile products

  • Built and maintained Flutter features across multiple products, integrating REST services, Firebase, analytics, payment SDKs, and third-party services in collaboration with backend and design teams.
  • Improved CirclePR feed loading by 40% through catalog segmentation, prefetching, and client-side caching; reduced production crashes by 80% and app size by 30% through profiling and targeted fixes.
  • Used Crashlytics and performance traces to investigate production issues, improve app stability, review code, and guide junior developers on implementation practices.

Multi-vendor mobile applications

  • Developed production features for multi-vendor applications, including responsive screens, checkout and payment flows, location services, and live order tracking.
  • Built reusable UI and business-logic components; improved API reliability with structured error handling, retries, caching, and pagination, and supported app builds and store releases.

Consumer, B2B, communications, and POS applications

  • Built and maintained production apps involving POS workflows, WebRTC communication, native-device capabilities, and platform-channel integrations.
  • Developed offline-first features with local databases, caching, queued API requests, and background synchronization; improved UI performance, contributed tests and code reviews, and supported app releases.
